items.title: PHP Critical Vulnerabilities: Affected Versions and Mitigations

items.title: Java4Shell: What We Know Now and What Comes Next
items.description: Update: OpenJDK, Oracle, and Calif have now published. This post reflects the official advisories, Calif’s full write-up, and our own lab results. Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) is a heap out-of-bounds write in OpenJDK’s hardware-accelerated Base64 decoder. It leaked before its patch, and it is now confirmed by OpenJDK and fixed in Oracle’s 17 November builds.
